chapterInfo.content:
7
Israel nnipa ɔpeha aduanan nnan no
1 # Dan 7.2; Sak 6.5; Mat 24.31 Yei akyiri no mehunuu abɔfoɔ baanan a wɔgyinagyina asase ntweasoɔ nnan no ano kurakura asase mframa nnan no mu, na mframa ammɔ amfa asase anaa ɛpo anaa dua biara so. 2Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔkura Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ no nsɔano sɛ ɔfiri owia apueeɛ reba, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ baanan a wɔama wɔn kwan sɛ wɔnha asase ne ɛpo no 3#Hes 9.4; 9.6 sɛ: Monnha asase anaa ɛpo anaa nnua kɔsi sɛ yɛde agyiraeɛ bɛsisi yɛn Nyankopɔn nkoa moma soɔ.
4 # Adi 14.1; 14.3 Na metee wɔn a wɔasɔ wɔn ano no dodoɔ: Mpem ɔha aduanan nnan na wɔasɔ wɔn ano Israel mma mmusuakuo nyinaa mu. 5Yuda abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dummienu, Ruben abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Gad abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, 6Aser abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Naftali abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Manase abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, 7Simeon abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Lewi abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Isakar abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, 8Sebulon abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Yosef abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Benyamin abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano, mpem dummienu.
Nnipakuo kɛseɛ no
9 # Adi 6.11 Yeinom akyiri no mehunui, na hwɛ, nnipakuo kɛseɛ a obi ntumi nkane wɔn, a wɔfiri aman, ne mmusuakuo, ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu no gyinagyina ahennwa no ne adwammaa no anim hyehyɛ ntade fitaa, na wɔkurakura berɛ. 10#Adi 12.10 Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ:
Nkwagyeɛ no yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ ne adwammaa no dea.
11 # Adi 5.11; 11.16 Na abɔfoɔ no nyinaa atwa ahennwa no ne mpanimfoɔ no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ho ahyia, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam, ahennwa no anim, na wɔkotoo Onyankopɔn 12#Adi 5.12 kaa sɛ:
Amen, nhyira ne animuonyam ne nyansa
ne aseda ne anidie
ne tumi ne ahoɔden
yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea daa daa. Amen.
Nkwagyeɛ a ɛnam adwammaa no so ba
13Na mpanimfoɔ no mu baako bisaa me sɛ: Yeinom a wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ yuu fitaa yi yɛ hwannom, na wɔfiri he? 14#Adi 3.10; Mat 24.21; Heb 9.14 Na meka mekyerɛɛ no sɛ: Owura, wo na wonim. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔfiri ahohia kɛseɛ no mu, na wɔahoro wɔn ntadeɛ ama no ahoa wɔ adwammaa no mogya no mu.
15 # Adi 11.19; 14.15; 14.17; 15.5; 15.8; 16.1; 21.3; 21.22 Yei nti na wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahennwa anim,
na wɔsom no awia ne anadwo n’asɔredan mu,
na deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no bɛkata wɔn so.
16 # Yes 49.10 Ɛkɔm renne wɔn bio, nso sukɔm renne wɔn bio,
nanso owia anaa
ahuhuro biara rento wɔn.
17 # Adi 5.6; Dwom 23.2; Adi 21.4; Yes 25.8 Na adwammaa a ɔwɔ ahennwa no mfimfini no bɛyɛ wɔn Hwɛfoɔ,
na ɔde wɔn akɔ nkwa asutire ho,
na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa nisuo nyinaa afiri wɔn aniwa mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yei akyiri no mehunuu abɔfoɔ baanan a wɔgyinagyina asase ntweasoɔ nnan no ano kurakura asase mframa nnan no mu, na mframa ammɔ amfa asase anaa ɛpo anaa dua biara so. Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔkura Onyankopɔn a ɔte aseɛ no nsɔano sɛ ɔfiri owia apueeɛ reba, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ baanan a wɔama wɔn kwan sɛ wɔnha asase ne ɛpo no sɛ: Monnha asase anaa ɛpo anaa nnua kɔsi sɛ yɛde agyiraeɛ bɛsisi yɛn Nyankopɔn nkoa moma soɔ.
Na metee wɔn a wɔasɔ wɔn ano no dodoɔ: Mpem ɔha aduanan nnan na wɔasɔ wɔn ano Israel mma mmusuakuo nyinaa mu. Yuda abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano si mpem dummienu, Ruben abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Gad abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Aser abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Naftali abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Manase abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Simeon abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Lewi abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Isakar abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Sebulon abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Yosef abusuakuo mu, mpem dummienu, Benyamin abusuakuo mu nnipa a wɔsɔɔ wɔn ano, mpem dummienu.

Yeinom akyiri no mehunui, na hwɛ, nnipakuo kɛseɛ a obi ntumi nkane wɔn, a wɔfiri aman, ne mmusuakuo, ne nkurɔfoɔ ne kasa nyinaa mu no gyinagyina ahennwa no ne adwammaa no anim hyehyɛ ntade fitaa, na wɔkurakura berɛ. Na wɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ:
Nkwagyeɛ no yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn a ɔte ahennwa no soɔ ne adwammaa no dea.
Na abɔfoɔ no nyinaa atwa ahennwa no ne mpanimfoɔ no ne ateasefoɔ baanan no ho ahyia, na wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam, ahennwa no anim, na wɔkotoo Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ:
Amen, nhyira ne animuonyam ne nyansa
ne aseda ne anidie
ne tumi ne ahoɔden
yɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn dea daa daa. Amen.

Na mpanimfoɔ no mu baako bisaa me sɛ: Yeinom a wɔhyehyɛ ntadeɛ yuu fitaa yi yɛ hwannom, na wɔfiri he? Na meka mekyerɛɛ no sɛ: Owura, wo na wonim. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔfiri ahohia kɛseɛ no mu, na wɔahoro wɔn ntadeɛ ama no ahoa wɔ adwammaa no mogya no mu.
Yei nti na wɔwɔ Nyankopɔn ahennwa anim,
na wɔsom no awia ne anadwo n’asɔredan mu,
na deɛ ɔte ahennwa no soɔ no bɛkata wɔn so.
Ɛkɔm renne wɔn bio, nso sukɔm renne wɔn bio,
nanso owia anaa
ahuhuro biara rento wɔn.
Na adwammaa a ɔwɔ ahennwa no mfimfini no bɛyɛ wɔn Hwɛfoɔ,
na ɔde wɔn akɔ nkwa asutire ho,
na Onyankopɔn bɛpepa nisuo nyinaa afiri wɔn aniwa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
